def move(terrain, start, duration_s, n_runs, seed):
    import numpy as np
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    steps = 60
    dt = duration_s / (steps - 1)
    points = np.empty((n_runs, steps, 3), dtype=float)
    lat0 = start[0]
    lon0 = start[1]
    points[:, 0, 0] = lat0
    points[:, 0, 1] = lon0
    points[:, 0, 2] = 0
    for i in range(1, steps):
        points[:, i, 0] = lat0
        points[:, i, 1] = lon0
        points[:, i, 2] = i * dt
    ok = terrain.inside(points[:, -1, 0], points[:, -1, 1])
    return points, ok
